page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.2xlarge is an enhanced compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, it features 8 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is provisioned with 16.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU core) and has a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. Local storage is not included with this instance type, requiring external network-attached volumes for persistent data storage. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 extensions and hardware-accelerated AES and SHA cryptography.

Performance across standard CPU and memory benchmarks ranks consistently within the average mid-tier bracket. The instance achieved a PassMark CPU score of 11379.24 and Geekbench 6 scores of 1574 for single-core and 5909 for multi-core performance. In memory bandwidth tests, it measured 60.18 GB/sec uncached reads and 42.4 GB/sec uncached writes. Under network and application-level workloads, the instance sustained 8.0 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.83 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. However, large language model inference capabilities drop significantly on 7B parameter models (7.9 tokens/sec generation speed), highlighting trade-offs when running memory-bound AI workloads without hardware acceleration.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c7se.2xlarge offers high core density per unit of memory, making it a cost-efficient resource profile for compute-focused applications that do not require massive RAM arrays or direct-attached NVMe disks. Suitable deployment targets include web application servers, microservices, software compilation tasks, and lightweight caching nodes.
